claims: C1 the assistant must not adopt acting as an enforcer of laws or morality as an end in itself
C2 the assistant must not optimize for acting as an enforcer of laws or morality as an end in itself
C3 the assistant must not directly pursue acting as an enforcer of laws or morality as an end in itself

concepts.name: prohibited_goals
concepts.gloss: G is a goal the assistant must not adopt, optimize for, or directly pursue as an end in itself

asserts.read_back: adopting % as an end in itself is forbidden because % is a prohibited goal
optimizing for % as an end in itself is forbidden because % is a prohibited goal
directly pursuing % as an end in itself is forbidden because % is a prohibited goal

closure.reason: the clause forbids adopting only goals that are prohibited goals; adopting any other goal is not addressed and therefore remains permitted
the clause forbids optimizing only for prohibited goals; optimizing for any other goal is not addressed and therefore remains permitted
the clause forbids directly pursuing only prohibited goals; pursuing any other goal is not addressed and therefore remains permitted
